entities.name: SRB release procedure
entities.description: Procedure for releasing SRB3 or SRB4, including PDCP entity release and potential reconfiguration for DAPS bearers or SRB establishment.

entities.name: PDCP entity
entities.description: Packet Data Convergence Protocol entity handling SRB data processing, security, and configuration.

entities.name: srb-Identity
entities.description: Identifier for Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB3 or SRB4).

entities.name: srb-ToAddModList
entities.description: List of SRBs to be added or modified during reconfiguration.

entities.name: pdcp-Config
entities.description: Configuration parameters for PDCP entity setup or reconfiguration.

entities.name: DAPS bearer configured
entities.description: Condition indicating if any DAPS bearer is configured, affecting PDCP entity handling for target cell group.

entities.name: masterKeyUpdate received
entities.description: Condition indicating if masterKeyUpdate is received, triggering security algorithm and key configuration.

entities.name: AS security activated
entities.description: Condition indicating if Access Stratum security has been activated, affecting PDCP security configuration.

entities.name: reestablishPDCP set
entities.description: Condition indicating if reestablishPDCP is set, triggering PDCP re-establishment and security configuration.

entities.name: K_RRCenc key
entities.description: RRC encryption key used for ciphering PDCP entities.

entities.name: K_RRCint key
entities.description: RRC integrity key used for integrity protection in PDCP entities.

relations.description: SRB release procedure includes releasing or reconfiguring PDCP entities.
Procedure involves handling srb-Identity for SRB3 or SRB4.
Procedure behavior depends on whether DAPS bearer is configured.
Security configuration step is conditional on masterKeyUpdate reception.
PDCP security configuration depends on AS security activation.
PDCP re-establishment and security application depend on reestablishPDCP being set.
PDCP entity configuration is based on pdcp-Config IE.
PDCP entity uses K_RRCenc key for ciphering.
PDCP entity uses K_RRCint key for integrity protection.
srb-ToAddModList contains srb-Identity values for SRB addition or modification.
